tasks.prompt: J12 is unavailable. What replacement can we use and what are the tradeoffs?
tasks.expected_answer: NSI-MF4-LK is available (560 units, 9-day lead, $0.71) and electrically pin-compatible. It is not a drop-in: mounting pegs differ, latch needs +2 mm chassis clearance, and WI-114/QA-FIX-C/BOM/PCB must change.

tasks.prompt: Which current production component presents the greatest shortage risk?
tasks.expected_answer: CM-4K-R2: only four global units, zero unrestricted, and 84-day lead. ALT-CAM-4K-L is available but requires mechanical, firmware, calibration, and power changes.

tasks.prompt: Can we source the higher-torque motor now?
tasks.expected_answer: Yes. MTR-24-290 has 96 unrestricted units and a 21-day lead. It fits the housing but triggers controller, driver, fuse, firmware, J12 thermal, test, and runtime consequences.
